skill.name: ir-velociraptor
skill.description: Guide Velociraptor VQL investigations, endpoint hunts, forensic artifact collection, and enterprise deployment for authorized incident response.
skill.summary: Create structured Velociraptor queries, hunts, artifacts, and evidence collection workflows for authorized endpoint investigations.
skill.author: AgentSecOps

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are documentation syntax, placeholders, or read-only defensive queries. Confirmed risks include remote script execution, privileged deployment, broad network exposure, and sensitive temporary files. CI bypasses and insecure deployment examples require correction before publication.

remediation.issue: Remote scripts and binaries execute without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact versions, download files separately, verify published signatures or checksums, and execute only after successful validation.

remediation.issue: CI scanners can fail without failing the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Remove unconditional success fallbacks, handle scanner errors separately from findings, and enforce documented severity thresholds.

remediation.issue: A CI action uses a mutable branch and other actions use mutable tags.
remediation.suggestion: Pin every third-party action to a reviewed commit SHA and use an automated process for controlled updates.

remediation.issue: The NFS export disables root squashing for the evidence datastore.
remediation.suggestion: Remove no_root_squash, restrict clients to a narrow network, apply least privilege, and protect evidence with immutable backups.

remediation.issue: Deployment guidance performs privileged and persistent host changes.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, document rollback steps, verify configurations, and test service and firewall changes in an isolated environment.

remediation.issue: Generated client configuration is written to a shared temporary path.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private directory with restrictive permissions, write atomically, and delete the configuration securely after deployment.

remediation.issue: Ransomware sample extraction lacks containment guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require isolated analysis systems, encrypted archives, access controls, malware labeling, and documented custody before sample extraction.

semantic_findings.title: Security scan failures are suppressed
semantic_findings.description: The CI template appends success fallbacks to several scanners. Tool failures and some findings can pass without an enforced security gate.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The template visibly uses success fallbacks after Semgrep, Safety, npm audit, and Checkov commands. Several jobs lack a reliable later failure check.

semantic_findings.title: Privileged binary installation lacks integrity verification
semantic_findings.description: The deployment guide downloads a Velociraptor executable and moves it into a privileged executable path without verifying a checksum or signature.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The displayed sequence performs wget, chmod, and sudo mv. No integrity verification appears between download and privileged installation.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable CI action can execute upstream changes
semantic_findings.description: The CI template runs the Trivy action from its mutable master branch. Future upstream changes can execute in repository workflows without review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The action reference is explicitly aquasecurity/trivy-action@master. A branch is mutable and does not provide immutable supply-chain pinning.

semantic_findings.title: NFS evidence store disables root squashing
semantic_findings.description: The NFS example exports the evidence datastore with no_root_squash. A compromised root client can write files as root on the server.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The export option no_root_squash is explicit on line 385. This removes a standard NFS protection for remote root users.

semantic_findings.title: Malware sample handling lacks isolation controls
semantic_findings.description: The ransomware workflow directs analysts to extract binary samples without specifying quarantine, encrypted packaging, or isolated analysis requirements.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly requests ransomware binary extraction. The surrounding steps do not state containment controls for handling executable malware samples.

critical_findings.title: Pipe to shell pattern

content.value_statement: Endpoint investigations require consistent queries, collection plans, and evidence controls. This skill provides Velociraptor workflows, VQL patterns, and deployment templates for authorized response.
actual_capabilities: Drafts VQL queries for process, network, file, registry, event log, and timeline analysis.
Structures endpoint hunts with targeting, resource limits, rollout controls, triage criteria, and reporting settings.
Guides custom Velociraptor artifact design with parameters, preconditions, queries, and validation steps.
Maps endpoint evidence and detection ideas to relevant MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
Provides server, client, offline collector, and CI configuration examples for review and adaptation.
limitations: It does not connect to Velociraptor or execute VQL without separate tools and authorized access.
Templates contain placeholders and require validation against the installed Velociraptor version.
Endpoint collection can expose sensitive data and requires legal approval, access controls, and retention policies.
Deployment examples require security hardening before production use.

use_cases.title: Triage a compromised endpoint
use_cases.description: Build a focused collection plan for processes, logons, network connections, persistence, and recent file changes.

use_cases.title: Design an enterprise threat hunt
use_cases.description: Create a staged hunt with endpoint labels, VQL artifacts, resource limits, positive indicators, and triage priorities.

use_cases.title: Develop a forensic artifact
use_cases.description: Define parameters, preconditions, data sources, expected output, tests, and MITRE ATT&CK mappings for a custom artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic endpoint triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Velociraptor triage plan for [incident type] on [operating system]. Include evidence priorities, artifact names, scope controls, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a focused VQL hunt
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a read-only VQL hunt for [indicator or behavior]. Explain each data source, filter, expected field, false positive, and resource limit.

prompt_templates.title: Design a custom artifact
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Velociraptor artifact for [forensic objective]. Include typed parameters, preconditions, bounded queries, output fields, test cases, and privacy controls.

prompt_templates.title: Review an enterprise deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Velociraptor deployment design: [details]. Identify trust boundaries, privileged operations, certificate handling, network exposure, storage risks, and safer configuration changes.

output_examples.input: Plan a hunt for suspicious PowerShell launched by office applications during the last 24 hours.
output_examples.output: A staged hunt plan covering process ancestry, command-line indicators, PowerShell logs, endpoint labels, time limits, result fields, and false positive review.

output_examples.input: Create an offline collection plan for a suspected ransomware incident.
output_examples.output: A scoped evidence plan covering event logs, timelines, persistence, hashes, resource limits, encrypted storage, chain of custody, and isolated malware handling.

output_examples.input: Review a Velociraptor server design that exposes the GUI to a large private network.
output_examples.output: A risk review recommending a narrow management subnet, strong authentication, TLS, role separation, audit logging, firewall validation, and tested recovery procedures.

best_practices: Obtain written authorization and define endpoint, user, data, and time boundaries before collection.
Start with read-only queries, small endpoint groups, strict resource limits, and documented validation.
Encrypt evidence, restrict access, record hashes, and preserve a complete chain of custody.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad hunts across production without staged testing and endpoint impact limits.
Do not collect credentials, browser data, or personal files without explicit necessity and approval.
Do not copy deployment commands before verifying binaries, network ranges, permissions, and service configuration.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Velociraptor queries?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and templates. Execution requires a separate Velociraptor installation, credentials, permissions, and user approval.

faq.question: Which operating systems are covered?
faq.answer: Most detailed examples target Windows. The deployment guide also includes Linux server and client examples.

faq.question: Can I use the templates without changes?
faq.answer: No. Replace placeholders, confirm artifact names, validate syntax, and review every privileged or network-facing setting.

faq.question: Does it support MITRE ATT&CK mapping?
faq.answer: Yes. The references connect common endpoint evidence and detection queries to ATT&CK tactics and techniques.

faq.question: How should sensitive evidence be handled?
faq.answer: Minimize collection, encrypt transport and storage, restrict access, document custody, and follow legal and organizational requirements.

faq.question: Is the deployment guidance production ready?
faq.answer: No. Production use requires checksum verification, pinned dependencies, narrow network access, protected keys, hardened storage, monitoring, and recovery testing.
